claims.text: On 22 June 2026 ODNI, with FBI support, announced a UAP Science Advisory Council led by Avi Loeb and reporting to a higher-level interagency UAP Governance Board; Nolan, Skafish, Gallaudet, Jacob Haqq-Misra and Ross Howard were named to it, and all data shared with the council is to be unclassified.

claims.sourceText: The Sol Foundation, 'Sol Foundation Co-Founders Named to UAP Science Advisory Council'
claims.text: In June 2026 the foundation announced that its co-founders Nolan and Skafish, senior adviser Tim Gallaudet, advisory board member Jacob Haqq-Misra and production lead Ross Howard had been named to the fourteen-member UAP Science Advisory Council, which reports to a higher-level UAP Governance Board and works only with unclassified data.

Sol Foundation co-founders Garry Nolan and Peter Skafish were named to the UAP Science Advisory Council; the foundation states the council was announced by the Office of the Director of National Intelligence with the support of the FBI and reports to an interagency UAP Governance Board.

edges.label: Chair and member of the same 2026 advisory council
edges.note: The astronomer who built the unclassified instrumentation programme and the pathologist who published the materials analysis now sit on the same federally requested body - with neither given classified access.

edges.label: Chair, appointed June 2026
edges.note: DefenseScoop reports Loeb formed and leads the council; the Sol Foundation says it was announced by ODNI with FBI support. The two accounts differ on its legal character.

edges.label: Council announced 17 June 2026, between Releases 03 and 04
edges.note: The council was announced as formed at the request of the White House and in coordination with AARO, ODNI, the FBI and other agencies, reporting to a higher-level UAP Governance Board.

edges.label: Named as the council's molecular biologist
edges.note: The scientist who published the first peer-reviewed UAP materials analysis is seated on a body with no access to the government's own materials.

edges.label: Astrobiology seat, via the Sol Foundation advisory board
edges.note: One of five Sol-affiliated appointments announced by the foundation in June 2026.

edges.label: Named as the council's cultural anthropologist
edges.note: Skafish's appointment completes the Sol Foundation's placement of its executive leadership on the federal advisory body.

edges.label: Gallaudet on Sol's Natural Sciences and US Government Advisory Boards
edges.note: 'Beneath the Surface: We May Learn More about UAP by Looking in the Ocean' opened the foundation's numbered series; Gallaudet was subsequently named to the 2026 advisory council.

edges.label: Sol leadership named to the ODNI/FBI council, 22 June 2026
edges.note: Nolan, Skafish, senior adviser Tim Gallaudet, advisory board member Jacob Haqq-Misra and production lead Ross Howard were all named; the foundation called it 'a fulfillment of its founding mission'.

edges.label: No budget, no classified access - constitutionally unable to reach the material
edges.note: The Associated Press reported the council has no budget and no access to classified material, and the Sol Foundation confirmed all shared data is unclassified. An advisory body denied money and clearances cannot audit a special access programme.

b.label: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

edges.label: Established by ODNI with FBI support
edges.note: ODNI announced the council following the PURSUE records releases; the FBI is named as supporting.

b.label: PURSUE - Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters

edges.label: Council established following the PURSUE releases
edges.note: Loeb's Medium account references a government disclosure release date of 12 June 2026 immediately before describing his tasking; the council's formation follows the release programme rather than preceding it.

edges.label: Advisory seat conditioned on unclassified-only access
edges.note: The council's announced terms guarantee its members will never see classified material. Recorded as a denial-type edge: the access granted is precisely the access that cannot resolve the question the members were appointed for.

edges.label: Gallaudet named to the council as its oceanographer
edges.note: A retired rear admiral and former acting NOAA administrator, and a Sol Foundation senior adviser, seated on the government's outside science body.

edges.label: reports to
edges.note: The council reports to the interagency UAP Governance Board, which the Sol Foundation describes as coordinating across military, law enforcement and intelligence community agencies.
